title: Private console object data
responsibility: Reads console JSON and media from a supplied private object store under one prefix.

inputs.name: consoleStore.bucket
inputs.description: Object-store binding providing asynchronous get calls that return text/byte readers or null for absent objects.

inputs.name: consoleStore.prefix
inputs.description: Optional object-key prefix, defaulting to empty; trailing slashes are removed when constructing a prefixed key.

outputs.name: consoleStore
outputs.description: Async JSON and media readers. JSON reads the requested relative key; media reads media/name and derives its MIME type from the extension, defaulting to application/octet-stream. Missing objects yield undefined.
